_comment: Experiment 42, arm B: Wang, Zhou, Zhang, Garoni, Deng, PRE 87 052107 (2013), Sec. II, taken literally: L = 8..512, 2.5e7 samples at each L ('at least 2.5 x 10^7'). Our model and observable (site, face_far, cylinder), not theirs (site/bond, largest cluster, periodic). About 3.8e15 cost units, ~250 GPU-hours, PER REPLICATE: do not run without a decision (README).
